reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coinbase Custody as an institutional product, describing its intended organizational clients and claimed custody features. The invitation to visit custody.coinbase.com is framed as learning more about the offering rather than requesting passwords, immediate payment, or private data, and the material does not show a rapid-return promise, deceptive mismatch, or victim-loss mechanism.

citations.quote: If you're an investment manager, we help you meet your regulatory obligations.
If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.
these are asset allocators, endowments, foundations, pension funds, family offices
we take the risk in holding and securing these assets away from you
each client has a segregated address on chain

opening.argument: Judge, the closing invitation should be read alongside the benefit being offered. The presentation says custody will let clients participate in their networks, specifically through staking, then directs institutions ready to invest to the custody website. That connects an investment-facing action to access to staking. The absence of a quoted yield does not erase the solicitation; it limits what we can say about its promised payoff.

citations.quote: We want to enable our clients to participate in their networks.
you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols
If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the website invitation as harmless because it says “learn more.” But that invitation is addressed to institutions ready to invest, after the presentation has described staking as something clients can do through custody. The institutional audience and custody features explain the pitch; they do not make the participation pitch disappear. Nor does the lack of a password request settle whether the invitation is investment solicitation.

citations.quote: If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.
We don't want custody to just be a place to securely store crypto assets.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This argument establishes only that the service is promoted to institutions that may invest in crypto assets. Staking is presented as one possible network activity alongside governance, not as a source of fixed, passive, or compounding returns. The stated next step is to learn more; the cited material does not ask viewers to fund a staking pool or promise a payoff.

citations.quote: you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols
come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The speaker calls Coinbase “the most trusted place,” cites a large amount already stored for customers, and describes assets as “always safe” in cold storage. The presentation then moves beyond storage to staking. Those assurances can reduce a prospective investor's sense of risk precisely where the service proposes participation in a crypto network. They are the video's own claims, not independent verification of the safety of that participation.

citations.quote: Coinbase is the most trusted place to buy and sell digital currencies in the world.
storing north of $20 billion on their behalf.
verify their assets are always safe in Coinbase Custody's cold storage.
you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to segregated addresses and an institutional audience as evidence of an ordinary custody service. But the speaker's own description says on-chain verification supports a claim that assets are “always safe”; the cited opening does not independently establish that conclusion. The defense also focuses on the lack of rapid-return promises while overlooking how emphatic safety claims can encourage participation in staking without quoting a rate.

citations.quote: This allows us and our auditors, as well as our clients, their auditors and administrators to go to the blockchain to verify their assets are always safe in Coinbase Custody's cold storage.
you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotional safety claims deserve scrutiny, but their presence does not establish a deceptive investment scheme. The presentation describes a custody arrangement with segregated on-chain addresses and operational due diligence. Its mention of staking supplies no return figure, recurring-income claim, or instruction to place assets into a pool. The cited scale and trust claims concern the provider, not an investment payoff.

citations.quote: each client has a segregated address on chain.
We have a really robust operational due diligence program.
engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols

opening.argument: Judge, this is more than an introduction to how custody works. It first identifies institutional holders and managers, then says the product should enable clients to participate in networks rather than merely store assets. Staking is named as one such activity, and the video closes by directing institutions ready to invest to the service website. The explanatory material serves a commercial path toward crypto participation; the ordinary-custody framing leaves that purpose understated.

citations.quote: these are asset allocators, endowments, foundations, pension funds, family offices
We don't want custody to just be a place to securely store crypto assets. We want to enable our clients to participate in their networks.
you have to be able to engage safely in things like staking, engaging in governance protocols
If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the video describes custody features, but that is not its whole message. It explicitly says custody should go beyond storage to network participation. The final invitation addresses institutions already considering investment. Describing the destination as a place to “learn more” does not negate the promotional role of the preceding explanation.

citations.quote: We don't want custody to just be a place to securely store crypto assets. We want to enable our clients to participate in their networks.
If you're one of those institutions and you're ready to invest in crypto assets, come to custody.coinbase.com to learn more.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video is plainly promotional, but promotion of a custody service is not itself evidence of a scam. It identifies institutional clients and describes custody, regulatory, and verification features. Network participation is mentioned as a future-facing capability alongside governance; there is no stated staking yield, passive-return promise, or requested investment payment. The closing request is to learn more about the service.
